entities.name: Nira
entities.description: Nacatl scout and Sunstriker born on Naya who came to Bant after the destruction wrought by followers of Nefarox; killed by Nefarox.

entities.name: Lia
entities.description: Girl Nira saved, who practiced stone breaking; renamed Kaa Lia or Kaalia and destroyed the dragon skeleton's keystone.

entities.name: Nefarox
entities.description: Grixis demon whose servants destroyed a village on Bant; he rose and killed Lia's family, the villagers and Nira.

entities.name: Bant
entities.description: Shard of Alara where a village was destroyed.

entities.name: Naya
entities.description: Shard of Alara where Nira was born and raised.

entities.name: Grixis
entities.description: Shard of Alara that is home to the demon Nefarox.

events.summary: Servants of Nefarox destroyed a whole village on Bant and Nira saved the girl Lia.
Nira named the girl Kaa Lia and asked her to destroy the keystone of the dragon skeleton the servants were reanimating; Kaalia succeeded.
events.quote: Kaalia successfully destroyed the dragon skeleton

events.summary: Nefarox rose and killed Lia's family, the remaining villagers and Nira.
events.quote: Nefarox rose and killed her family, all the remaining villagers, and Nira herself.

relations.quote: Nefarox rose and killed her family, all the remaining villagers, and Nira herself.
